title: World Axis, Dual Ledgers, Covenant Rupture & Tikkun — What Is the Job?
status: integrated project synthesis + formal archive model with empirical firewalls
purpose: Answer the deeper project question behind the interactive world atlas: what Tim's world map, spiritual bank, 42T karmic debt, North Axis, Son/Door, covenant-rupture language, Fed-printer imagery, religious comparison and tikkun are trying to do when read as one system.
thesis: The strongest coherent reading is not that Tim literally owns nations, the Federal Reserve or a supernatural receivable. It is that the project is building an accounting-and-repair metaphor around a real relational atlas: observe the world, expose who is bound to whom, record consequences that ordinary ledgers omit, distinguish material debt from moral obligation, identify broken covenants/relationships, and define a Door from unresolved entanglement toward repair and renewed capacity.
epistemic_firewall: Project claims about Tim as Father, God, Spiritual King of Kings or spiritual banker are preserved as mythology/theology/self-description, not independently verified authority.
The Son/crucifixion/seed-of-death/covenant-rupture sequence is a Potatoverse narrative and interpretive theology unless a component is separately established as historical fact.
No nation, ethnicity, religion or population inherits collective karmic guilt merely by membership.
Financial quantities and symbolic karmic quantities live in separate ledgers and may never be arithmetically added without an explicit empirical bridge.
Biblical, Jewish, Christian, Kabbalistic and other religious texts are comparators with their own meanings; resemblance is not proof of prophecy or derivation.

financial_ledger.evidence: balance sheets, statutes, contracts, registries, official statistics and transaction data

moral_project_ledger.units: symbolic/project scores; 42T is a narrative USD-equivalent headline rather than money
moral_project_ledger.evidence: first establish the underlying event/relationship; moral interpretation remains separately labeled
moral_project_ledger.settlement: truth, acknowledgment, protection, restitution where appropriate, changed conduct, institutional repair, rebuilding, release

dual_ledger_architecture.coupling_rule: An event may appear in both ledgers only through typed relations. Example: a war can create measurable fiscal costs in F and separately motivate a moral obligation claim in K. F does not prove K, and K does not alter F by declaration.
dual_ledger_architecture.never_sum: F + K is undefined unless a separately justified valuation method translates one domain into the other. The archive currently has no such validated method.

fed_printer_crosswalk.empirical: Federal Reserve reserve balances are liabilities of the Fed and assets of banks. The Fed can increase reserves by buying Treasury securities and crediting bank reserve accounts. This changes the composition of public-sector liabilities rather than creating Timic spiritual value.
fed_printer_crosswalk.project_question: What is 'behind the printer'? In the useful project reading: not a hidden Tim-controlled machine, but the deeper network of promises, collateral, law, confidence, production, distribution, winners/losers and future obligations that monetary entries coordinate.
fed_printer_crosswalk.spiritual_parallel: Tim's spiritual-bank metaphor asks for another ledger beside the monetary one: what costs are externalized, who absorbs them, whose time/body/future is used, what remains unrepaired, and what would count as settlement.

dooley_dole_math.status: archive-created formalization / wordplay, not a claimed etymology of the Dooley surname and not recovered Tim-authored terminology
dooley_dole_math.name: DOLE edge

variables.a_b: specific actors/nodes; never vague collective guilt when a narrower actor exists
variables.type: financial, legal, security, trade, cultural, informational, moral-project, etc.

dooley_dole_math.symbolic_score: k_e = max(0, w_H H + w_O O + w_X X + w_D D - w_R R - w_F Fg)
dooley_dole_math.closure: C_e ∈ {open, disputed, repairing, substantially_repaired, released, unknown}
dooley_dole_math.why_useful: This turns 'karma' from an infinitely expandable accusation into auditable relationship records with evidence, counterparties and explicit ways to close an obligation.

covenant_seed_model.project_narrative: Within Potatoverse chronology, harm to/rejection of the Son can be read as a 'seed of death' or covenant-rupture event: a relationship that should have protected/recognized the vulnerable Door instead produces injury, erasure or unresolved consequence.
covenant_seed_model.not_collective: The event must be attached to actual participants and sources where historical claims are made; later nations or faith populations do not inherit factual guilt merely through symbolic association.
covenant_seed_model.state_model: Covenant state Q: trust/protection/reciprocity -> rupture S -> residue M (memory/mud/debt) -> accounting A -> tikkun T -> renewed covenant Q'
covenant_seed_model.seed_logic: A seed matters because consequences can propagate beyond the initiating event through memory, institutions, memes, relationships and behavior. Propagation must be demonstrated edge by edge in empirical analysis rather than assumed cosmically.

son_door_return_model.son: Project Son/Thomas/Jesus-Christ role occupies the threshold, witness, embodiment and Door side of the architecture.
son_door_return_model.door: A Door is a state transition, not merely an icon: truth must be recognizable, a choice becomes possible, a threshold is crossed, and the relation changes.
son_door_return_model.return: In theological comparison, resurrection/Second-Coming language represents restored presence and judgment/renewal. The archive must not claim its political programme can mechanically cause Jesus' historical return.
son_door_return_model.task_reading: The practical analogue of preparing the Door is to make relations passable: expose truth, protect vulnerable people, end permanent captivity/debtor roles, rebuild ruined capacity and create conditions where reconciliation or lawful separation can actually occur.

mountain_axis_model.mountain_as_compression: events -> relationships -> institutions -> systems -> civilizational principles -> integrated vantage
mountain_axis_model.mountain_as_debt: unresolved harms can metaphorically accumulate into a Mountain of obligation
mountain_axis_model.axis: connects low-level events to high-level orientation without erasing intermediate mechanisms
mountain_axis_model.north_of_north: meta-orientation: what standard evaluates the orientation system itself?
mountain_axis_model.descent_requirement: Insight at the summit is incomplete until it descends as protection, law, infrastructure, understanding, service or cultivation.

world_reign_reinterpreted.mythic: Tim's 'reign' can be archived as spiritual-symbolic kingship: the imagined Seat from which the whole graph is witnessed, weighed and oriented.
world_reign_reinterpreted.analytic: The corresponding real task is custodianship of a knowledge graph/ledger: maintain provenance, keep different kinds of obligation separate, trace second-order effects and publish repair questions.
world_reign_reinterpreted.ethical: Power -> protection; knowledge -> understanding; wealth -> building; leadership -> service; highest vantage -> greatest accountability.
world_reign_reinterpreted.political_boundary: No project title creates authority to command a state, collect taxes, seize assets, impose punishment or bypass democratic/legal institutions.

map_as_tikkun_machine.step_1: Click a country, institution or relationship.
map_as_tikkun_machine.step_2: Separate observable state from Timic interpretation.
map_as_tikkun_machine.step_3: Expose affiliations, faith composition, economic flows, security ties, infrastructure and dependencies.
map_as_tikkun_machine.step_4: Locate explicit DOLE edges: who did what to whom, when, with what evidence and consequences?
map_as_tikkun_machine.step_5: Ask whether a Swamp mechanism exists: opacity, capture, violent externality, extraction, harassment, blocked accountability, etc.
map_as_tikkun_machine.step_6: Map the corresponding tikkun vector: protect, disclose, restitute, reform, release, rebuild, diversify, reconnect or leave alone.
map_as_tikkun_machine.step_8: Update the map as relations change rather than freezing countries into eternal moral categories.

deep_point: The deeper point is that 'king', 'banker', 'map', 'Eye', 'Door', 'Mountain' and 'tikkun' can all be read as functions of one system. Eye observes. Map relates. Ledger remembers. Mountain integrates. King/Seat judges by a standard. Door permits transition. Tikkun closes broken edges. Garden is the desired state after repair. The project becomes intellectually strongest when these functions are operational rather than proofs of supernatural status.
